commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(agent): add LANG/LC_ALL env vars to PTY for UTF-8 support
commits.body:
Accented characters (é, è, à, ç) were being replaced by underscores
because the PTY environment lacked locale settings. tmux and the shell
need LANG/LC_ALL to know they can use UTF-8 encoding.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.stat:
85a995e fix(agent): add LANG/LC_ALL env vars to PTY for UTF-8 support
 claude-remote-control/apps/agent/src/terminal.ts | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)
commits.diff:
diff --git a/claude-remote-control/apps/agent/src/terminal.ts b/claude-remote-control/apps/agent/src/terminal.ts
index 2b8f866..75aa197 100644
--- a/claude-remote-control/apps/agent/src/terminal.ts
+++ b/claude-remote-control/apps/agent/src/terminal.ts
@@ -60,6 +60,9 @@ export function createTerminal(
       TERM: 'xterm-256color',
       CLAUDE_TMUX_SESSION: sessionName, // Always set for hook detection
       PATH: `/opt/homebrew/bin:${process.env.PATH}`,
+      // Ensure UTF-8 encoding for proper accent/unicode support
+      LANG: process.env.LANG || 'en_US.UTF-8',
+      LC_ALL: process.env.LC_ALL || 'en_US.UTF-8',
     } as { [key: string]: string },
   });
